title: Forgotten Letters
explanation: A chest full of letters becomes an invisible thread binding two strangers together.
content:
None of the letters had ever been sent. Cevat found them in the lighthouse cellar, in a damp chest — each in the same careful hand, but addressed to a different name.

Ravi was the first to read them. And the more he read, the more he began to see his own name between the lines.

Some words wait years for the one they are meant for. All they need is for someone to read them aloud.
